note: All 2026 regulations current as of Aug 15, 2026. No API exists for these - all data hardcoded from official sources.

requirements.details: Mandatory 5-business-day advance notice before goods arrive at US port
requirements.documentation: FDA Form 2 (Prior Notice)

requirements.details: Exporting country must issue health certificate within 30 days of shipment
requirements.documentation: Government-issued health certificate from exporting country authority

requirements.details: Banned substances: Chloramphenicol, Nitrofurans, Fluoroquinolones. Mandatory testing required.
New FDA Food Traceability Final Rule - compliance deadline passed Jan 20, 2026
requirements.documentation: Traceability records for all catch/processing steps
requirements.citation: FDA Food Traceability Rule; FDA Feb 2, 2026 announcement

requirements.details: FDA prioritizing imported shrimp from India and Ecuador; increased inspection for food safety
requirements.documentation: Extra scrutiny on processing facilities, traceability, antibiotics
requirements.citation: FDA 2026 Human Foods Priorities; FDA announcement Jan 29, 2026

frameworks.scoring_contribution: Up to 10 points for full compliance

requirements.details: Mandatory digital traceability system; went live Jan 8, 2026
requirements.compliance_cost: Integrated with UK import system (no additional fee)
requirements.documentation: Vessel registration + digital tracking in Fish Trace Ship
requirements.deadline: All imports must use system since Jan 8, 2026

requirements.details: Vessel IMO/ID must be traceable to catch origin. Each catch batch requires vessel verification.
requirements.documentation: Vessel IMO number, licensing documents, catch logs
requirements.citation: FSA Traceability Requirements; Food Information Regulations 2014

requirements.details: Fresh/chilled fish must reach UK within 10 days of harvest. After 10 days, must be frozen.
requirements.documentation: Catch date + arrival documentation
requirements.citation: FSA Fresh Fish Standards; Food Information Regulations 2014

requirements.details: Alignment with FDA FSMA standards for UK importers
requirements.documentation: Same as USA antibiotic/health cert requirements

red_flags: Vessel not in Fish Trace Ship system
Fresh fish >10 days old at arrival
frameworks.scoring_contribution: Up to 10 points for full compliance

requirements.details: EU's new catch documentation system; mandatory since Jan 9, 2026 (6+ months operational)
requirements.documentation: CATCH certificate with vessel IMO, catch details, landing port
requirements.deadline: IMMEDIATE - all pre-cleared catches require CATCH
requirements.citation: EC Reg. 1379/2013; EU Commission Jan 9, 2026 activation

requirements.details: Ship's IMO number MUST be included in CATCH certificate. No exceptions.
requirements.documentation: IMO certificate (International Maritime Organization)
requirements.critical: MUST HAVE - no exports possible without IMO

requirements.details: Vessel must NOT be on FAO Global Record blacklist. EU conducts mandatory FAO check.
requirements.documentation: FAO Global Record verification
requirements.citation: EU PSMA; FAO Global Record; Implementing Reg. 2018/1135

requirements.details: Full supply chain traceability per international standard
requirements.documentation: Farm-to-table traceability documentation

requirements.details: EU-specific health certificate required (different from USA/UK)
requirements.documentation: Government health certificate on EU form

requirements.details: Same banned substances as USA. Mandatory testing for shrimp.
requirements.testing_requirement: Extra stringent for shrimp (EU is strict)

frameworks.scoring_contribution: Up to 15 points (highest weight) for full compliance

requirements.details: Biosecurity Import Conditions system; requires permit BEFORE goods arrive
Effective June 1, 2026; specific products require Official Government Certificate
requirements.affected_products: Retorted salmon roe, caviar; some finfish products
requirements.documentation: Official government certificate confirming product standards

requirements.details: Vessel must be on DAFF Approved Register. Unregistered vessels = AUTO-REJECT
requirements.citation: AFMA (Australian Fisheries Management Authority); DAFF regulations

requirements.details: Different from USA/UK/EU. Australia-specific health documentation required.
requirements.documentation: DAFF-approved health certificate

requirements.details: Reefer containers must maintain temperature logs. Cold chain break = rejection.
requirements.documentation: Continuous temperature records from export to arrival

red_flags: Vessel not on DAFF Approved Register
BICON permit not obtained before shipment
frameworks.scoring_contribution: Up to 15 points (highest weight) for full compliance; STRICTEST COUNTRY

active_programs: RCMC (Registration Certificate for Marine Fisheries Products)

requirements.details: Registration Certificate for Marine Fishing Vessels. MUST have RCMC to export.
requirements.documentation: RCMC issued by MPEDA
requirements.citation: MPEDA regulations; DADF Order 30035/15/97-Fy(T-1) Vol.IV dated 10/03/2017

requirements.details: No fishing June 1-Jul 31 (Arabian Sea) or Apr 15-Jun 14 (Bay of Bengal)
requirements.documentation: Landing centre receipt + catch date documentation

requirements.details: Domestic health certificate from approved Indian lab
requirements.documentation: Health certificate on CIFT/CMFRI letterhead

requirements.details: Catch origin, landing centre, processing facility documented for traceability
requirements.documentation: Landing centre record + processing facility registration

requirements.details: Species must be on CMFRI sustainable stock list (Apr 30, 2026 assessment)
requirements.documentation: CMFRI health index ≥90 for export species

red_flags: Species not on CMFRI sustainable list
frameworks.scoring_contribution: Up to 10 points for full domestic compliance
